methods.displayName: Smelt a carried bronze bar at Edgeville furnace

start.instruction: Smelt one exact carried copper ore and one exact carried tin ore. Stop when either input is exhausted; no ore acquisition is modeled.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 1 required to smelt bronze.

freeInventorySlots.description: No additional empty position: two input positions become one bronze-bar position.

produces.basis: One bronze bar per normal-furnace action.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the bronze-knife tier or selected goal boundary.
Recheck when loose copper ore is exhausted.
Recheck when loose tin ore is exhausted.

costs.assumptions: One normal-furnace action is modeled. Mining, shop supply and further bar processing are outside scope.

methods.reason: A deterministic early Smithing transformation using exact carried ores.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for one verified carried smelt; no gathering loop or hourly rate.

sources.notes: The UIM guide favors quests early but confirms Smithing's inventory constraints; this record supplies a real data-backed path without adding quests.
Normal-furnace bronze requires level 1 and one copper plus one tin ore, producing one bronze bar.
Public furnace access was reviewed; no bank use is inferred.
Exact copper ore, tin ore and bronze bar identities use pinned public gameval constants.

methods.displayName: Smith carried bronze bars into knives

start.location: Anvil south of Varrock west bank
start.instruction: Use the carried hammer to smith one exact bronze bar into five unpoisoned bronze knives. No bar acquisition or later ammunition use is assumed.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 7 required to smith bronze knives.

freeInventorySlots.description: No additional empty position: the consumed bar position can hold the knife stack.

setupItems.description: One exact ordinary hammer in inventory; it is returned, not consumed.

produces.basis: Five unpoisoned bronze knives per bar.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the iron-platebody tier or selected goal boundary.
Recheck when loose bronze bars are exhausted.

costs.assumptions: One bar is scoped. The hammer remains carried and output knives form one exact observed stack.

methods.reason: Compresses one carried bar into stackable Ranged ammunition while advancing Smithing.

requirements.description: One exact ordinary hammer in inventory.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for one verified bar and returned hammer; no supply loop or combat value is scored.

sources.notes: The UIM guide links Smithing outputs to early Fletching and Ranged use; this scope begins with carried bars.
Level 7, hammer, anvil and one bronze bar producing five stackable unpoisoned knives were reviewed.
Exact hammer, bronze bar and unpoisoned bronze knife identities use pinned public gameval constants.

methods.displayName: Smith a carried iron platebody at Varrock

start.location: Anvil south of Varrock west bank
start.instruction: Use the carried hammer to smith five exact loose iron bars into one iron platebody. No ore, Superheat, alchemy or disposal loop is assumed.

hardRequirements.description: Unboosted level 33 required to smith an iron platebody.

freeInventorySlots.description: No additional empty position: five consumed bar positions become one platebody position.

setupItems.description: One exact ordinary hammer in inventory; it is returned, not consumed.

consumes.description: Five exact loose iron bars for one platebody.

produces.basis: One unnoted iron platebody per five bars.

stopConditions.description: Re-evaluate at the current RFD unboosted Smithing target.
Recheck when fewer than five loose iron bars remain.

costs.assumptions: One platebody is scoped. Superheating, mining, alching and disposal are separate unsupported transitions.

methods.reason: The UIM guide's best pre-40 anvil product becomes an immediate bounded action when five bars and a hammer are already carried.

requirements.description: One exact ordinary hammer in inventory.

efficiencyProfiles.notes: Editorial value for the verified five-bar action and its inventory compression; no mining, alchemy or hourly rate.

sources.notes: The UIM guide identifies level-33 iron platebodies as the fastest product in its pre-40 mine, superheat and smith route; this record starts only with carried bars.
Level 33, hammer, anvil, five iron bars and one iron platebody output were reviewed.
Exact hammer, iron bar and iron platebody identities use pinned public gameval constants.
